name: Hellwood Hookups
source:
When Hiro and Katsu came to Hellwood for a vacation, they were expecting smooth sailing from their usually-hectic lives. But once the casual flings become fate-changing events, what was once a getaway weekend plunges them deeply into supernatural politics.

[From [url=https://mega-gh0st.itch.io/hellwood-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当宏和胜来到地狱伍德度假时，他们期待着从平时忙碌的生活中一帆风顺。但一旦偶然的风流韵事变成了改变命运的事件，曾经的度假周末就会让他们深深陷入超自然的政治之中。
